Class ReportsPanel

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Container
javax.swing.JComponent
javax.swing.JPanel
ManagerPage
ReportsPanel
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable, Accessible
public class ReportsPanel extends ManagerPage
Manager > Ordering Trends: sales by day, top drinks, low stock, sales by item, and inventory used for a date range, plus the X-report for one day.

      private void refreshXReport()
